name: Contura
description: Melodic contour over selectable 12-TET scale sets, anchored to the device tonic

sections.heading: Scale sets / LEDs
items: Flat list of named 12-TET sets (Ionian…Folk) — conventional interval-pattern labels, not cultural claims
Follow device tonic (default on); Follow device scale uses the global Key mask instead of the selected set
Button hue cycles by scale index · Top = gate · Bottom = pitch height · Division via config (default 1/16)

channels.jackDescription: Quantized melodic pitch (1V/oct / range param). Gate is MIDI note on/off.
channels.faderDescription: Max scale-degree step size (narrow → wide leaps)
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Phrase length 4–24 steps and how often new notes vs rests fire
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Repeat/short notes ↔ leaps and longer holds
channels.fnDescription: Short press mutes/unmutes. Long press cycles the scale set.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Shift+short = previous scale set · Shift+long = octave span 1→4
channels.ledBottom: Pitch height within the current span
